name: Halloween Doubao
author: wynn
variant_note: A Halloween portrait edition by wynn, distinct from the same author's app-avatar and ivory-cardigan editions. It preserves the recognizable chestnut bob and app-avatar face while adding a black witch hat with an orange band, a purple-lined cape, a pumpkin clasp and a lavender circular fill. All nine state animations and sixteen v2 gaze directions are newly AI-generated for this costume.
source_notes: AI-generated Halloween adaptation and animation based on wynn's Doubao App Avatar pet, used as an appearance reference. The user approved the new main look before animation. description: Doubao dresses up for Halloween in a black witch hat, purple-lined cape and pumpkin clasp. A lavender circle frames the portrait; outside it is transparent. Nine state animations and sixteen v2 look directions keep the costume consistent.
